traditional: 搞到 A 目瞪口呆
jyutping: gaau2 dou3 A muk6 dang6 hau2 daai1

english.note: Use this when something leaves someone completely dumbfounded or speechless rather than merely startled.

examples.english: This news can stun me into silence.
examples.traditional: 呢個消息搞到我目瞪口呆。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 muk6 dang6 hau2 daai1
